Key it by runner OS and the best available checked-in dependency inputs (lockfiles when present; otherwise dependency manifests, Makefile/install declarations and workflow setup). Keep the change narrow so those same commands still run and can pass; the measured CI runs determine whether the candidate succeeds and whether it helps. If the method has a limitation, record it in rationale but still implement the closest valid version of the selected method. Return ONLY JSON: {pattern_id, decision: APPLY, rationale, workflow_yaml}. workflow_yaml must contain the complete changed file.

# `push` is limited to master because a PR branch in this repo would otherwise fire
# both `push` and `pull_request` for the same commit, queueing two identical runs of
# the five-way Python matrix. Branch pushes are still covered — via `pull_request`
# once a PR is open.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:

# Superseded runs are pointless once a newer commit exists on the same ref, and they
# hold runners that the newest commit is waiting on.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  POETRY_VERSION: 1.8.5

jobs:
  Tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        PYTHON_VERSION: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.PYTHON_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          allow-prereleases: true

      - name: Install and configure Poetry
        uses: snok/install-poetry@v1
        with:
          version: "${{env.POETRY_VERSION}}"

      - name: Set up micromamba
        uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@v2
        with:
          environment-file: environment.yaml
          # `environment.yaml` carries `python >=3.10,<3.15`; this narrows the
          # solve to one specific version per matrix entry.
          create-args: >-
            python=${{ matrix.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          micromamba-version: latest
          init-shell: bash
          cache-environment: true
          post-cleanup: 'all'

      # Runtime deps are installed by `setup-micromamba` from environment.yaml so we
      # get conda-forge wheels (which cover newer Pythons — notably cp314 — that PyPI
      # doesn't yet ship wheels for). We then install pixy itself with `--no-deps`
      # to avoid re-resolving them from PyPI, and use poetry only for the dev-tool
      # group (ruff, mypy, pytest, etc.) since those are pure-Python and trivially
      # wheel-available everywhere.
      - name: Install the library
        shell: micromamba-shell {0}
        run: |
          poetry config virtualenvs.create false
          pip install --no-deps -e .
          poetry install --only dev --no-root -vvv

      # Run each check as its own step so a failure in (e.g.) ruff isn't masked by a
      # passing `pytest` at the end of a single multi-line `run:` block.
      - name: Check formatting (ruff format)
        shell: micromamba-shell {0}
        run: poetry run ruff format --check --diff

      - name: Lint (ruff check)
        shell: micromamba-shell {0}
        run: poetry run ruff check

      - name: Type check (mypy)
        shell: micromamba-shell {0}
        run: poetry run mypy

      - name: Run tests
        shell: micromamba-shell {0}
        run: poetry run pytest

name          = "pixy"
version       = "2.2.4"
description   = "An unbiased estimation of average nucleotide diversity within (π) and between (dxy) populations from a VCF"
readme        = "README.md"
authors       = [
    "Katharine Korunes <kkorunes@gmail.com>",
    "Kieran Samuk <ksamuk@gmail.com>",
]
license       = "MIT"
include       = ["LICENSE"]
homepage      = "https://github.com/ksamuk/pixy"
repository    = "https://github.com/ksamuk/pixy"
documentation = "https://pixy.readthedocs.io/en/latest/about.html"

[tool.poetry.dependencies]
python       = ">=3.10,<3.15"
numcodecs    = ">=0.13"
numpy        = ">=1.24,<3"
scikit-allel = ">=1.3.13"
typing-extensions = "*"

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
mypy        = "^1.13.0"
pytest      = "^9.0.3"
pytest-cov  = "^5.0.0"
ruff        = "0.7.4"
ipython     = "^8.0"
ipdb        = "^0.13"

[tool.poetry.scripts]
pixy = "pixy.__main__:main"

[build-system]
requires      = ["poetry-core>=1.6"]
build-backend = "poetry.core.masonry.api"

[tool.poe]
poetry_command = "task"

[tool.poe.tasks]
fix-format = "ruff format"
fix-lint   = "ruff check --fix"

fix-all.ignore_fail = "return_non_zero"
fix-all.sequence    = [
    "fix-format",
    "fix-lint"
]

check-lock   = "poetry check --lock"
check-format = "ruff format --check --diff"
check-lint   = "ruff check"
check-tests  = "pytest"
check-typing = "mypy"

check-all.ignore_fail = "return_non_zero"
check-all.sequence    = [
    "check-lock",
    "check-format",
    "check-lint",
    "check-tests",
    "check-typing"
]

fix-and-check-all.ignore_fail = "return_non_zero"
fix-and-check-all.sequence    = [
    "fix-all",
    "check-all"
]

[tool.mypy]
files                       = ["./"]
mypy_path                   = "./stubs"
strict_optional             = true
strict_equality             = true
check_untyped_defs          = true
disallow_incomplete_defs    = true
disallow_untyped_calls      = true
disallow_untyped_decorators = true
disallow_untyped_defs       = true
no_implicit_optional        = true
warn_no_return              = true
warn_redundant_casts        = true
warn_return_any             = true
warn_unreachable            = true
warn_unused_configs         = true
warn_unused_ignores         = true
enable_error_code           = "ignore-without-code"
exclude                     = [
    "debug/",
    "docs/",
    "site/",
]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = [
    "allel",
    "numpy",
]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "7.4"
addopts    = [
    "--color=yes",
    "--import-mode=importlib",
    "--cov"
]
markers = [
    "regression: marks SLOW regression tests (deselect with '-m \"not regression\"')",
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length    = 100
target-version = "py310"
output-format  = "full"
preview        = true

[tool.ruff.lint]
select    = [
    "ARG",    # Unused arguments
    "C901",   # McCabe complexity
    "B",      # bugbear
    "D",      # pydocstyle (docstrings. We have the "google" convention enabled)
    "D204",   # Blank line between class docstring and first (__init__) method
    "D213",   # Summary line should be located on the line after opening quotes
    "E",      # pycodestyle errors
    "LOG",    # flake8-logging
    "F",      # pyflakes
    "I",      # isort
    "N",      # PEP8 naming
    "W",      # pycodestyle warnings
    "Q",      # flake8-quotes
]
ignore    = [
    "E203",
    "E701",
    "D212",  # summary line should be located on the same line as opening quotes
    "D100",  # Missing docstring in public module
    "D104",  # Missing docstring in public package
    "D105",  # Missing docstring in magic method
]
unfixable = ["B"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
force-single-line = true

[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]
convention = "google"
